notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Griffins.
description:
Cast Misthollow Griffin by paying {4}.
When Misthollow Griffin enters, Mirror of Life Trapping and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Griffin you control.
Resolve the Mirror of Life Trapping trigger, exiling Misthollow Griffin.
Repeat.
